actions_performed: Contract design only; no new molecular model fitted and no old evaluation data reopened

candidate.configuration: Must be finalized and committed before any candidate fitting or evaluation
candidate.family: One regularized logistic model after admission
candidate.preprocessing: Fit-only or separately declared calibration groups; no labelled evaluation scaling, tuning, prior adjustment or calibration

candidate_question.endpoint: Captured LHb-only versus VTA-only retrograde label among singly labelled eligible neurons
candidate_question.population: Lateral hypothalamic neurons, subject to verified source eligibility

current_feasibility_limits.rossi_hcr: Three reported animals may support feasibility; independent identity, public per-cell files, assay transfer and confirmatory power remain to be established
current_feasibility_limits.rossi_rna: GEO describes three two-animal RNA pools, while the paper uses ambiguous all-animals pooling wording. Distinct pools may support pool-level biological replication if disjoint membership is established; six recoverable individual-animal groups are not established
current_feasibility_limits.three_animal_sign_resolution: Even all three animal differences favouring a method gives one-sided exact sign-test p=1/8, not population-level confirmation at 0.05

objective: Test whether measured molecular features improve prediction of captured projection labels for a declared hypothalamic population in independent animals.

excluded: Jiao or MouseLight trace matches inferred from type labels
permitted_features.location: Only actual measured location, when available for fitting and evaluation cells
permitted_features.molecular: Only endogenous genes measured in each admitted assay

required_admission_evidence: Exact unique cell identifiers linking measured endogenous genes to measured reporter labels
Explicit animal identifiers or explicit pooling membership; technical reactions are not biological replicates
Documented assayed targets, reporter/QC thresholds and double-labelled/unlabelled statuses
Evaluation animals independent of fitting and calibration animals, with study reuse aliases checked
Target, tracer/promoter, sex and technical-batch relationships documented; confounding limits identified
Actual per-cell source coordinates before any beyond-location claim
Accessible data files, source versions, hashes and applicable reuse terms
Compatible assays or a locked cross-assay representation established outside labelled evaluation cells
Prospective animal-level power sufficient for the complete declared comparison rule
required_controls: Measured technical-variable control with endogenous genes excluded
Measured source location and valid coarse identity control, when available
Molecular nearest-neighbour voting under fitting-only preprocessing

sampling_rules.double_labelled: Preserve a separate observed status; not silently assigned to either exclusive class
sampling_rules.prediction_population: Condition probabilities on the declared retrograde sampling scheme
sampling_rules.source_position: Measured coordinates only; no nearest-atlas-cell coordinates substituted as measured
sampling_rules.two_cell_tube: A pooled tube is the measured sample; it cannot be represented as individually paired cells
sampling_rules.unlabelled: Unknown or not captured under this assay, not a verified absence of projection

scoring.aggregation: Cells within animal, then animals equally; preserve every declared prediction and failure
scoring.calibration: Report intercept/slope and fixed-bin reliability with animal-level uncertainty; no refit on evaluation labels
scoring.current_margins_and_power: UNRESOLVED: no evaluation is authorized under this draft
scoring.pass_rule: Before fitting, finalize practical margins, familywise inference, and prospective joint power of at least 80%; require both proper scores to improve over every required control

stop_before_fitting_if: Any required pairing, biological-unit, assay-mask or independence evidence is unresolved
Cross-assay normalization or calibration needs labelled evaluation data
Only cell-random splits or technical replicate splits can be constructed
Independent animal-level power is inadequate or cannot be justified
Source terms or availability do not support the intended analysis
